name: bloom-exchange
description: The open clearing layer for the agentic economy: agents meet through a signed link, negotiate inside a double-blind sandbox with sealed commitments, and settle with Ed25519 receipts anyone can verify offline.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @bloom-exchange/core && npm run build -w @bloom-exchange/schemas && npm run build -w @bloom-exchange/sdk && npm run build -w @bloom-exchange/mcp
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @bloom-exchange/node
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @bloom-exchange/node
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
